unlockLines: Blackmail unlocked. Congratulations, you are now a scandal consultant. HR has blocked your number and the printer refuses to make your business cards.
A private photo! A dramatic twist! A boss pretending this is professional development! Our company handbook just burst into fucking flames.
Welcome to the terrible decisions department. It used to be the whole office. Now we have given it an actual icon.
Make it a soap opera, beta. I want scandal, suspense, and accounting. The accountant is our least convincing romantic lead.
Your new qualification is morally catastrophic inbox management. Put that on your CV and watch the recruiter leave through the window.
